# Elevate Your Life at Moonglade - Luxury 3 & 4 BHK Residences in Kokapet

> Moonglade is a premium high-rise luxury residential community in Kokapet near Financial District, Hyderabad, offering 3 & 4 BHK apartments across 7 towers, 40 floors, 14 acres, and a 135,000 sq. ft. clubhouse with world-class amenities.

## Project Description
- [About Moonglade Kokapet](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Luxury 3 & 4 BHK residences designed for modern families
- [Project Highlights](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Premium architecture, amenities, and strategic location near ORR Exit 18A

Elevate your life at Moonglade — a landmark luxury development in Kokapet crafted for families who seek superior living, expansive homes, and world-class amenities in Hyderabad’s fastest-growing residential corridor.

## Developers & Collaboration
- [E-Infra & IRA Developers](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Signature collaboration behind the Moonglade project
- [Developer Projects](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Portfolio of residential and commercial developments

E-Infra and IRA Realty are two of Hyderabad's most progressive real estate enterprises, steadily transforming the city's skyline with iconic projects. Bringing luxury living spaces, pioneering architecture, and amenities that are second to none — they are carving a name for themselves among the city's elite and exclusive circles.

E-Infra, founded in 2017, specializes in residential and commercial projects including luxury apartments, villas, and office spaces. IRA Realty, founded in 2019 by Narsi Reddy, focuses on developing residential and commercial properties driven by their philosophy, "Every buyer is a shareholder", reflecting a transparent and buyer-centric approach to real estate ownership.

## Key Project Specifications
- [Location - Kokapet, Opp. Exit 18A](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Prime location near Financial District
- [Total Apartments - 2489 Units](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Large-scale premium residential community
- [Project Area - 14 Acres](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Landscaped and master-planned development
- [Towers - 7 High-Rise Towers](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Iconic skyline architecture
- [Structure - 2 Basements + Stilt + 4 Podium + 40 Floors](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Modern high-rise construction
- [Apartment Sizes - 1400 to 3950 sq. ft.](https://beseen.moonglade.life/#plans): Spacious luxury configurations
- [Starting Price - From ₹1.33 Cr*](https://beseen.moonglade.life/): Premium pricing for luxury segment

- [Wellness Facilities](https://beseen.moonglade.life/#amenities): Spa, salon, meditation zones, fitness areas
- [Sports Amenities](https://beseen.moonglade.life/#amenities): Squash, badminton courts, and outdoor sports zones
